phone.goal: Provision one dedicated customer-facing mobile number for LUNDUS DIGITAL SYSTEMS under a business-appropriate account.
must_have: registered to or contractually controlled for LUNDUS DIGITAL SYSTEMS
suitable for WhatsApp Business or equivalent business messaging
no requirement to expose owner's existing SSM-recorded telephone

current_shortlist.notes: Official Maxis business terms recognise sole proprietorships as Business Customers. eSIM is available to active Maxis Business Postpaid customers.

current_shortlist.official_price_observed: from RM58/month on current official business page
current_shortlist.notes: Current official CelcomDigi Business page states plans are open to new/existing business customers and shows business tiers from RM58.

phone.selection_rule: Choose the lowest-friction business-registered line with acceptable Labuan coverage, no unnecessary device contract, and clear business-account evidence. Coverage/availability must be confirmed at registration time.

address.goal: Use the existing SSM-registered business address as LD's authoritative business address; do not procure a replacement address.
address.rule: Do not treat address existence and public display as the same decision. The existing registered address is valid as the business address; publication remains human-gated because it overlaps residential information.
